answer: The signal assignment is published and ember records each panel. Shards are assigned from the saffron graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1927 identities would post 2015 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
